answer: Pay agents by independence, not headcount. Each epoch, compare every identity's errors and timing; when one slip ripples identically through a cluster, the network treats that cluster as a single agent and splits one reward among them. Like juniper berries on one branch, clones share a root and fail together. Only an honest, onyx-hard track record of uncorrelated mistakes earns a full share, so spawning copies adds cost but no extra income.
